push.title: L 0-3 vs UBEREAT | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #4)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a perfect 10.0 against UBEREAT. Perfect Game #4. I don't have a speech for this. I'm just gonna stand here and clap.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 4th Perfect Game for us. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ A goal against UBEREAT. One swing, one goal, zero doubt.
+ 1 key pass. That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ Man of the Match, your 9th for us. Put that one on the fridge.
+ Match rating 10.0, up from your usual 7.8. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Pro tip: Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost. Little by little.
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Mark my words: Low shots across the keeper are the hardest to save and the easiest to tap in on the rebound. Small fix, big smile.
- On-ball actions 16, down from your usual 29. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- 3 goals conceded: -0.1. Like leaving the porch light on all day. Small, but it adds up.
- Your 3rd straight loss. A team result, and it needs a team answer.

Session plan: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

BellyTb1, take this with you: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

Gold star, big hug, see you next match. - Coach Lasso

- That loss cost us one of our chances in Division 3. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.
- Lost 0-3 to UBEREAT. Learn it, leave it.

PhogsToffees, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Quiet feet, loud heart.

Rest up and reset. - Coach Lasso
